P3.hypothesis: A third Carnivore will make its access-trash ability available earlier and more often, improving Loup's access pressure. This is a prediction, not an observed result.
P3.opportunityCost: One fewer cheap +1 MU/+1 hand-size T400, a 2-credit card replaced by a 4-credit card, and more redundant consoles (Carnivore text limits one console/player).
P3.knowledgeSources: Carnivore and T400 text read in actual builder Read full card previews; Loup pressure description from lobby; consistency/hypothesis/evaluation method from reviewer judgment, not guide.
P3.plan: Play six baseline and six revised Gateway games against exact Built to Last · Advance & threaten, alternating lists and holding opponent/settings stable. For each game log first Carnivore drawn/installed turn, useful activations by turn 6, duplicate consoles stranded, turns T400's missing MU/hand size would matter, and credits/clicks spent to establish rig. Separate missing-draw from unaffordable-install failures. Compare access-trash availability and cost, report raw counts and examples, treat wins as secondary preliminary observations. Revert extra Carnivore if duplicates/cost outweigh useful earlier access trash; choose next small revision from repeated bottleneck. No games performed.
